hypothesis_title: STR_1715 Factor Beta Hedge — Cross-Sectional Statistical Factor Regression (MDD + Vol)
hypothesis_description: STR_1715 PG2 100% live MDD -32.05% gap. 통계적 팩터 only — cross-sectional regression. Method: rolling cross-sectional regression of stock returns on statistical factor mimicking portfolios (PCA-derived OR factor analysis) → loadings B matrix (n×K) → portfolio factor beta β_p,k = B'w → crisis-prone factor (highest beta in 6 위기 historical exposure) 식별 → minimize crisis-prone factor exposure (β_p,k_crisis) under long_only + Σw=1 + cap. STR_1715 alpha ranking 무손상 (input only). Statistical estimation only. Academic anchor: Fama-MacBeth (1973) 2-step regression + Bai (2003) inferential statistics for large factor models.

crisis_prone_identification.approach: historical 6 위기 시 factor return distribution → highest mean drawdown 또는 lowest mean return factor 식별 (statistical only)

hedge_objective.minimize: portfolio beta on crisis-prone factor (β_p,k_crisis = B[:,k_crisis]' w)

decision_rule.PASS: CAGR ≥20% + MDD ≤-25% OR -3pp + vol -20% + Sortino ≥1.0 + top5DD 3+ + factor R² OK
decision_rule.MONITORING_ONLY: factor regression quality OK + trading damage 큼
decision_rule.FAIL: CAGR <20% OR MDD/vol 개선 없음 OR factor identification 불안정

axiom_constraints.AX-002: factor selection + crisis-prone identification SHA-frozen, OOS 변경 X
